7307637.name: Chabad of North Port
7307637.note: COLlive, 14 June 2026 ('New Shluchim to Florida's West Coast'): 'Rabbi Srolik and Nechama Sputz, together with their son Levi, will be establishing Chabad of North Port, Florida' (south Sarasota County). IRS: Chabad Of North Port Inc (care of Yisroel Sputz), exempt from July 2026. Both give 2026.

4629871.name: Mikvah Beit Yosef
4629871.note: The mikvah of Chabad of Panama City Beach (mikvah.org: 4117 Thomas Drive; supervised by Rabbi Mendel Havlin). COLlive, 24 Dec 2018: Rabbi Mendy and Chaya Havlin 'are moving to Panama City Beach ... and will establish a Chabad House there'; COLlive (31 Aug 2020): the community was helping them buy a home and Chabad center. So the mikvah came after 2018; when it opened is not found. (Achdut Israel's mikvah in Panama City Beach, about 2014-15, is a different one.) Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about 2019.

117605.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Tampa Bay
117605.note: Chabad.org, 13 July 2011 ('Tampa Suburb Awaits First-Ever Synagogue'): Rabbi Yossi and Sulha Dubrowski 'have directed Chabad-Lubavitch of Tampa Bay for more than 30 years and run Hebrew Academy, a Jewish day school for students in preschool through eighth grade', so it existed by 1981 (therebbesimpact.com's 1994 is wrong). The St. Petersburg Times (CrownHeights.info, 22 July 2011): they lead it in the Carrollwood area (now 14908 Pennington Road). Its first year is not found.
